newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch oilseed crush up 5.6 pct in first half.
newsitem.headline: Dutch oilseed crush up 5.6 pct in first half.

text.p: Dutch oilseed firms crushed 2.49 million tonnes of seed in the first half of the year, 130,000 tonnes or 5.6 percent more than in the same 1996 period, the Dutch Oils and Fats Board (MVO) said on Monday.
The soy crush rose 4.4 percent to 2.03 million tonnes, producing 366,000 tonnes of oil against 362,800 in 1996.

Processing of sunflowerseed increased by 4.4 percent to 310,800 tonnes, with oil production up to 144,500 from 128,600 tonnes. The rapeseed crush jumped to 94,500, a hefty increase on the 57,900 tonne figure in 1996, when high prices dented the crush. Rapeoil output rose to 39,000 tonnes from 23,300.
